run_split_km_cli: run the split_km script to split a km file into train valid and test sets
run_split_km_shuffle: run the split_km script with shuffle enabled to randomize lines before splitting
run_split_km_custom_percentages: run the split_km script with custom valid and test percentage values
run_split_km_seed: run the split_km script with a custom random seed for reproducible splits
review_split_km_script: review the split_km script that splits km files into train valid and test sets
